deals.description: VIENNA, LET’S RUN 🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️🔥 The HOS Run Club is officially here — and we’re kicking things off with our very first Community Run on 25.10. We’ll start at 11:00 at HOS and run around 5.8 km through Vienna — passing TU, Karlsplatz, Staatsoper, Stadtpark and Belvedere before finishing at 15 Süße Minuten. The run is completely free to join. And if you want to stay a little longer, you can add our optional community brunch at afterwards for €10.90 p.p., including a welcome drink. Chia Pudding • Multigrain Bagels • Fit Bowls • Fresh Fruit & Veggies • Sweet Bites & more 25.10. · 11:00 Start: HOS, Graf-Starhemberg-Gasse 39, 1040 Vienna All you need to do is sign up via the link in our bio and let us know if you’re joining the brunch too. Run with us. Meet the community. Stay for brunch. 🤍 ".
